requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Syntactic ambiguities regarding phrase attachment and possessive antecedents resolved via controlled context (glossary, business rules). Decomposed into two independent functional requirements per business rule BR-01: one for adding a downstream system, one for enabling a subscription. Both interpreted as actions performed by System-A.

source_fragments: add System-B to their downstream systems
structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A shall add System-B to its downstream systems.
structuring_notes: Resolved 'their' to 'its' (System-A) based on domain context. Action is autonomous system activity.

source_fragments: allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow

fields.object: System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow

structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A shall allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.
structuring_notes: Resolved ownership of 'Reporting flow' to System-A per glossary and business rule BR-01. Treated as independent operation from adding downstream systems.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not assume specific subscription protocols or data formats.
